description: Asks how grouping, de-duplication, ordering and extremes treat the stored edge strings of Tx: GROUP BY T with Count, DISTINCT T, DISTINCT M and GROUP BY M (Memo), ORDER BY T and T DESC with ID as tie-break, First(ID) by group, Min and Max of T and of M, UNION and UNION ALL of T with itself, a derived DISTINCT count, HAVING Count(*) > 1, and DISTINCT over UCase(T). Each form is one snapshot, followed by DBEngine.Errors. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
